gamerule.bettercushionplacement.allow_in: Ignores #cushion_uses_collision_shape block tags, thus allowing sub-pixel cushion placement on the inner walls of cauldrons, composters, and hoppers without a data pack.
gamerule.bettercushionplacement.cushions: Instead of only being supported by blocks, cushions can also be supported by other cushions, allowing direct stacking.
